pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown polygonal regions characterized by high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients. Geometric area is maximal on the upper flank and lower neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented and irregularly shaped clusters toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light beige negative space. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-point and quad-point intersections. Pixel thickness of pathways is non-uniform, appearing narrower on the mid-flank and widening toward the ventral and dorsal regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible dorsal neck line exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette composed of dark pixel clusters against the background.
